title: Free hosted AI candidates for a custom chat

verification.method: Official documentation, pricing and public endpoint metadata; no account signup, private credential inspection or authenticated model inference.
verification.meaning: Documented route is not an end-to-end integration test. Unknown quotas and entitlements remain unknown.

candidates.name: Kilo Gateway
candidates.free: Free models: 200 requests/hour/IP; upstream limits may also apply.
candidates.integration: Documented OpenAI-compatible gateway.
candidates.notes: Select an explicitly zero-priced model. Do not assume all Kilo models are free.

candidates.name: NVIDIA API Catalog / NIM
candidates.free: Free prototyping; FAQ says up to 40 requests/minute for most models, no per-token billing.
candidates.integration: Cloud model endpoints, API key, streaming examples.
candidates.notes: Actual limit depends on model, traffic and account. Free prototyping is not a production capacity guarantee.

candidates.name: Z.ai
candidates.free: GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash: input and output priced Free; GLM-4.6V-Flash is also Free.
candidates.integration: Model inference API.
candidates.notes: GLM-5.3-Flash is paid. Fixed daily free quota is not published on pricing page.

candidates.name: Vikasit Inference
candidates.free: 2,000,000 tokens/day on Vikasit Nova, according to provider.
candidates.integration: OpenAI-compatible API; provider example uses https://api.vikasit.ai/v1 and model vikasit-nova.
candidates.notes: Free allocation is for Nova, not the entire catalog or paid CLI subscription. Quality and reliability not benchmarked.

candidates.name: Requesty
candidates.free: 200 requests/day on designated free models; no credit card required.
candidates.integration: OpenAI-compatible API at https://router.requesty.ai/v1.
candidates.notes: Free model list rotates. Requesty terms distinguish free-plan data handling from paid accounts.

candidates.name: GroqCloud
candidates.free: Free tier with per-model request and token caps. Public table shows GPT-OSS-120B at 30 RPM, 1,000 RPD, 8,000 TPM and 200,000 TPD.
candidates.integration: Cloud API with OpenAI compatibility and OpenCode integration docs.
candidates.notes: Check the account limits page; cached tokens do not count toward limits according to docs. Token cap can bind before request cap.

candidates.name: Google AI Studio / Gemini API
candidates.free: Input and output are free on selected models; model/project rate limits apply.
candidates.integration: Direct Gemini API.
candidates.notes: Do not reuse historical Gemini CLI 1,000/day figures as current API quotas. Free model availability and quotas must be read from current project.

candidates.name: OpenRouter
candidates.free: :free model variants: 20 RPM and 50 requests/day without credit purchase; 1,000/day after buying $10 of credits.
candidates.integration: OpenAI-compatible API; openrouter/free router available.
candidates.notes: The 1,000/day lane requires an initial purchase and is not zero-spend. Other zero-priced model types can have different rules.

candidates.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
candidates.free: 10,000 Neurons/day on Workers Free; resets at 00:00 UTC.
candidates.integration: Workers bindings or REST API.
candidates.notes: Neurons are not tokens. Several frontier models require a paid billing method or prepaid AI Gateway credits.

candidates.name: Novita AI
candidates.free: Apodex 1.1 Mini is listed with Free input and output pricing.
candidates.integration: Model API and playground.
candidates.notes: Free rate limit, account funding requirement and duration were not established by the reviewed pricing page.

candidates.name: OpenCode
candidates.free: Rotating free models; most fixed quotas unpublished. LongCat 2.5 Free lists 100 requests/day.
candidates.integration: V1 official headless server and JS/TS SDK; verify installed V1/V2 version before implementation.
candidates.notes: Console states free-tier chat models require OpenCode; other clients cannot be assumed to have direct free API access. Keep the OpenCode bridge as a candidate.

candidates.name: Cline
candidates.free: Rotating, limited-time free model promotions with usage quotas; numeric daily amounts unpublished.
candidates.integration: Official CLI supports headless operation and --json output.
candidates.notes: Current free-model docs explicitly exclude the Cline API. Earlier repository API examples conflict; current free-model page takes precedence. Investigate the official CLI route.

candidates.name: Qoder International
candidates.free: Daily manual claim of 100 Credits in desktop app; each grant valid 30 days; campaign end unannounced.
candidates.integration: Official qoder -p, JSON and stream-json; promotion lists Qoder CLI among eligible products.
candidates.notes: Credits are not requests. Claiming does not unlock paid-only features.

candidates.name: Tencent CodeBuddy
candidates.free: Free plan: 100 credits/month; limited-time daily activity reward 30 credits/day.
candidates.integration: Official codebuddy -p / --print and JSON/stream-json input/output.
candidates.notes: Daily reward requires a valid client conversation and is credited the following day. CLI applicability and feature entitlement should be tested with a free account.

candidates.name: Google Antigravity
candidates.free: Individual $0 plan with weekly agent limits; numeric weekly allowance unpublished.
candidates.integration: Official agy -p, --output-format json or stream-json; uses cached authenticated credentials.
candidates.notes: Unlimited Tab/Command labels must not be interpreted as unlimited agent inference. Model eligibility changes.

candidates.name: GitHub Copilot
candidates.free: Free plan includes limited AI usage. Code completion allowance is not a chat/agent request allowance.
candidates.integration: Official Copilot SDK integrates the CLI agent into apps and services.
candidates.notes: SDK FAQ points to a Free tier with limited usage. Do not use old 50-message figures without current confirmation.

candidates.name: Kiro
candidates.free: 50 credits/month on perpetual Free tier.
candidates.integration: Official headless CLI exists; current docs describe API-key authentication.
candidates.notes: API-key creation docs name paid tiers. Do not assume free account headless access just because headless exists; verify browser-login behavior and current entitlement.

candidates.name: OpenAI Codex
candidates.free: Codex is included in ChatGPT Free; current Free pricing mentions desktop GPT-6 Luna subject to rollout; fixed quota not established.
candidates.integration: Official codex exec, SDK, app-server and Sign in with ChatGPT developer flows.
candidates.notes: An integration surface existing does not prove Free-account access to every surface/model. Standard API-key usage is paid separately.

candidates.name: AIHubMix
candidates.free: Live quota JSON: daily_request_limit=100, daily_token_limit=1000000, minute_limit=10, trial_unpaid_request_limit=10, paid_threshold_usd=1; per-model weights apply.
candidates.integration: Documented direct APIs and live model/quota discovery.
candidates.notes: Do not advertise 100/day as unconditional zero-spend. Live quota config overrides generic free-model marketing; determine the $1 paid-threshold semantics and per-model requirements before selecting.

candidates.name: SimpleLLM.eu
candidates.free: Zero-priced models exist; exact active hourly/daily request/token budgets depend on configuration.
candidates.integration: Direct OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible chat routes; authenticated rate-limit endpoint.
candidates.notes: One running free-model request per account across keys; published docs warn catalog aliases can refer to disabled backends.

candidates.name: LLM7.io
candidates.free: Up to 100,000 input+output tokens per rolling 24 hours; educational/research use; 250 text requests/hour.
candidates.integration: API token issued through dashboard.
candidates.notes: Terms require prior written approval to proxy/embed/provide access to third parties. Keep as a candidate, with personal-use versus public-service conditions separated.

candidates.name: SenseNova Token Plan
candidates.free: Official search index advertises a CNY 0 public beta. Exact active quota not live-verified.
candidates.integration: Marketing lists API keys and Hermes/OpenClaw integrations.
candidates.notes: Search snippets include older numeric claims; do not treat 60,000 credits/5h or 1,500 calls/5h as verified current limits. Korea signup/account access untested.

candidates.name: Clixad
candidates.free: 60,000 shared usage credits/day; provider estimates ~123 DeepSeek V4 Flash turns at 20K input+1.5K output tokens per turn.
candidates.integration: Official open-source CLI exists; supported headless/server interface not established.
candidates.notes: A global daily free budget can stop usage before the account quota. Models resume spending credits after the free limit.

candidates.name: Freebuff
candidates.free: Current plans page advertises 30 daily hours for full access, model multipliers and account-dependent eligibility.
candidates.integration: CLI/SDK source exists, but free external integration is restricted in current terms.
candidates.notes: Earlier region article says South Korea 12h while current plans page differs; do not give a definitive Korean-account quota without login. Terms restrict wrappers, automation and relaying free inference; investigate separately documented SDK rights or approved routes, do not claim technically impossible.

candidates.name: Pollinations
candidates.free: Quest Pollen rewards for eligible activities; no passive daily allowance established in current FAQ.
candidates.integration: Direct generation APIs and app-user authorization (BYOP).
candidates.notes: Old free daily tier/Pollen tables are stale. Some models require Paid Pollen. Quest availability and rewards vary.

candidates.name: Mistral Vibe
candidates.free: Free plan lists limited coding sessions; exact numeric quota unpublished.
candidates.integration: Official vibe --prompt / -p with JSON output.
candidates.notes: Do not infer free general API access from Vibe's free plan. Confirm the actual free-account model and programmatic entitlement.

candidates.name: Cursor
candidates.free: Current Free plan has limited Agent and Chat requests; exact numeric quota unpublished.
candidates.integration: Official CLI print automation exists.
candidates.notes: Current plan differs from historical Hobby/Pro pricing. Verify Free CLI model availability before assuming a usable pool.

candidates.name: CoStrict
candidates.free: Docs list weekly 50 Credits for registered users maintaining a GitHub Star, plus limited daily basic-model usage.
candidates.integration: Official cs serve, cs run --format json and CSC programmatic/Agent SDK routes.
candidates.notes: Signup reward amounts differ between docs and campaign page; do not commit to one amount. Actual daily basic-model quota unpublished.

candidates.name: Google Jules
candidates.free: 15 tasks per rolling 24h and 3 concurrent tasks on Free.
candidates.integration: Official REST API and Jules Tools CLI.
candidates.notes: An asynchronous coding task service, not a drop-in conversational completion API. Keep as a task-backend candidate.

candidates.name: Devin / current Windsurf pricing destination
candidates.free: Free plan lists a light agent quota; numeric quota unpublished.
candidates.integration: API product is listed, but Free-plan API entitlement is not established.
candidates.notes: Do not equate free desktop agent usage with free cloud/API access.
